ResearchProjectDef.label: Adeptus Astartes vehicles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Vehicle patterns of the Adeptus Astartes: Rhino-pattern hulls, Land Raiders, gunships and drop pods for power-armoured Space Marines. Needs astronavigation and powered armour.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Adeptus Custodes vehicles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Antigrav patterns of the Adeptus Custodes: jetbikes, Caladius grav-tanks and Orion gunships. Needs astronavigation, the finest power armour and gravitic drives.
